metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/ replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory on the Marvin arm rig (1,167 controls; the turner is picked up from the counter, the replay ends at success after 1,017 controls) in both modes; it succeeds in two fresh processes with identical state hashes, also with float32-rounded rows.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task.
